grounding: Derived from docs.paytheory.com / llm-docs: sdk/javascript/{hosted_fields,event_listeners,errors,functions}. Published docs are authoritative; confirm specifics there before advising.

result_types.note: result.type uses FAILED for a failed transaction. The transaction body status/state may still use FAILURE; do not compare result.type against FAILURE.

ACTION_COMPLETE.meaning: An action has completed and cannot be run again.
ACTION_COMPLETE.fix: Clear and re-mount the fields before running another action.

ACTION_IN_PROGRESS.meaning: An action is already in progress.
ACTION_IN_PROGRESS.fix: Wait for the current action to finish before calling transact/tokenize again; disable the submit button while in progress.

FIELD_ERROR.meaning: Error mounting the Pay Theory fields.
FIELD_ERROR.fix: Confirm the container divs exist with the exact IDs and are visible/sized; ensure payTheoryFields runs after the DOM is ready.

INVALID_PARAM.fix: Check the arguments passed to payTheoryFields/transact against the functions docs; amount must be an integer in cents.

NO_FIELDS.meaning: No fields were found on the DOM to mount.
NO_FIELDS.fix: Add the correct hosted-field container IDs to the DOM and confirm they exist before initializing.

NO_TOKEN.meaning: No session token found — typically a network failure.
NO_TOKEN.fix: Check network/connectivity and the API key; refresh and retry.

NOT_READY.meaning: The SDK is not yet connected and ready.
NOT_READY.fix: Gate the action on readyObserver; do not call transact before the fields are ready.

NOT_VALID.meaning: The transacting field is not valid when the function ran.
NOT_VALID.fix: Wait for validObserver to report the payment type valid before calling transact; have the user correct the field data.

SESSION_EXPIRED.fix: Refresh the page to start a new session, then retry.

SOCKET_ERROR.fix: Refresh and retry; check network and that the SDK import URL matches the environment.

TRANSACTING_FIELD_ERROR.meaning: Multiple transacting fields, or no transacting field visible on the DOM, when running a function.
TRANSACTING_FIELD_ERROR.fix: Mount exactly one transacting field set and ensure it is visible (not display:none) when transact runs.

fields-not-rendering.summary: The hosted card/ACH fields do not appear on the page.

causes.check: Confirm the exact IDs are present in the DOM (combined: pay-theory-credit-card; separate: -number/-exp/-cvv).
causes.fix: Use the exact IDs from the hosted_fields docs.

causes.cause: SDK script not imported or wrong Import URL
causes.check: Confirm the SDK <script> import is present and matches the environment (Lab vs Live).
causes.fix: Import the correct environment SDK URL from the portal.

causes.cause: payTheoryFields ran before the containers exist
causes.check: Is init inside DOMContentLoaded / after the divs render?
causes.fix: Initialize after the DOM/containers are present.

causes.cause: SDK dynamically loaded inside DOMContentLoaded, then payTheoryFields stays pending
causes.check: If payTheoryFields returns Promise <pending> and document.querySelectorAll('iframe') stays at 0 with no console error, check whether the SDK script is created/appended inside a DOMContentLoaded handler.
causes.fix: Prefer the docs-style static SDK script import. If the SDK URL must be loaded from runtime config, call payTheoryFields only after document.readyState === 'complete' or window.load.

causes.check: Are containers visible and at least min width (number 340px, combined 400px)?
causes.fix: Give containers visible size; remove display:none.
Allow the Pay Theory SDK frame in your Content-Security-Policy.

transact-returns-error.summary: transact resolves with result.type ERROR (or throws an SDK error).

causes.fix: Gate transact on validObserver; let the user fix field data.
Call transact only after readyObserver fires.
Mount exactly one visible transacting field set.
Refresh to renew the session and retry; verify connectivity and API key.

causes.check: Is amount a whole number of cents (not dollars)?
causes.fix: Pass amount as an integer number of cents (e.g. $10.00 -> 1000).

result-type-confusion.summary: Code never hits the failure branch, or mis-handles a failed transaction.

causes.fix: Branch on SUCCESS / FAILED / ERROR. result.type for a failed transaction is FAILED; FAILURE only appears in the transaction body status/state.

causes.check: Are observers set before initializing the fields?

fields-never-valid.summary: validObserver never reports the payment type valid, so transact can't run.

causes.check: Is validObserver wired and gating the submit button?
causes.fix: Use validObserver (passes 'card' | 'ach' | 'cash'); enable submit on valid.

causes.check: Are all required fields for the payment type mounted (e.g. number/exp/cvv + zip)?
causes.fix: Mount the full required field set, or pass billingInfo for zip.

styling-or-sizing.summary: Fields render but look wrong, are clipped, or styles are ignored.

causes.check: Are you setting keys outside the fixed style-object schema?
causes.fix: Use only the documented style keys; others are silently ignored.
